parrafo_1.es: Blush Studios es un estudio de fotografía y producción en White Plains. Ahí se hacen retratos, headshots y sesiones familiares, y el mismo espacio se renta para que otros creadores hagan sus propias sesiones de foto y video.
parrafo_1.en: Blush Studios is a photography and production studio in White Plains. It is where portraits, headshots and family sessions happen, and the same space is rented out so other creators can run their own photo and video shoots.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes describen el trato como cálido y paciente, incluso en sesiones delicadas: desde familias con niños pequeños hasta headshots durante procesos personales difíciles. El objetivo es que la sesión se sienta relajada, y que eso se note en las fotos.
parrafo_2.en: Clients describe the experience as warm and patient, even in delicate sessions: from families with toddlers to headshots taken during a hard personal chapter. The goal is for the session to feel relaxed, and for that to show in the photos.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué tipo de sesión buscas (retrato, headshot, evento familiar o renta del espacio) a través de la ficha de Google.
texto.en: Tell us what kind of session you are after (portrait, headshot, family event or renting the space) through the Google listing.

texto.es: Coordinamos fecha, duración y lo que necesitas llevar o preparar antes de llegar al estudio.
texto.en: We coordinate the date, the length of the session, and what you need to bring or prepare before you arrive at the studio.

texto.es: Trabajamos con calma, ajustando luz, pose y maquillaje hasta que te sientas a gusto frente a la cámara.
texto.en: We work calmly, adjusting light, pose and makeup until you feel at ease in front of the camera.

texto.es: Recibes tus fotos editadas. Clientes destacan que la comunicación es rápida y el resultado final, cuidado.
texto.en: You receive your edited photos. Clients highlight that communication is fast and the final result is polished.

nota.es: No publicamos precios ni paquetes en Google: escríbenos por la ficha de Maps y te contamos el detalle según tu sesión.
nota.en: Pricing and packages are not published on Google: reach out through the Maps listing and we will walk you through the details for your session.

texto.es: Headshots profesionales y retratos individuales, con atención a la pose, la luz y el maquillaje frente a cámara.
texto.en: Professional headshots and individual portraits, with attention to pose, lighting and on-camera makeup.

texto.es: Sesiones pensadas para familias, incluso con niños pequeños, y celebraciones como cumpleaños.
texto.en: Sessions built for families, including toddlers, and celebrations like birthdays.

items.quote: Amazing experience for my birthday photos!! Very attentive, creative and executed my vision perfectly

Mariah was absolutely amazing from start to finish! It had been a very long time since I had updated my headshots & she made the experience fun and stress-free. She was very professional, was fast with communication & delivered a high quality product. Highly recommended!

I am so grateful for this space and the Blush studio staff. I really needed new headshots, but was hesitating because I had been going through Cancer treatment. Mariah, the Studio Owner was so patient and understanding.

Mariah at Blush Studios LLC is absolutely amazing. From the moment my family and I walked in, she welcomed us so warmly and immediately made us feel comfortable. Even with our very inquisitive 2-year-old, she was patient, kind, and knew exactly how to work with all of us.
